enums.name: ApmDatabaseAuthentication
enums.summary: How the frontend authenticates to the ClickHouse database for APM data (<c>APM_GLOBAL_DB_AUTHTYPE_*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>).

members.name: Password
members.summary: With a user name and password (0).

members.name: None
members.summary: Without authentication (1).

enums.name: ApmDatabaseStatus
enums.summary: Whether the ClickHouse database for APM data is configured (<c>APM_GLOBAL_DB_STATUS_*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>).

members.name: NotConfigured
members.summary: Not configured; the frontend shows no APM data (0).

members.name: Configured
members.summary: Configured (1).

enums.name: ApmMetricType
enums.summary: The type of an OpenTelemetry metric that Zabbix stores (<c>APM_METRIC_TYPE_*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>).

members.name: Gauge
members.summary: A gauge: a value sampled at a point in time (0).

members.name: Sum
members.summary: A sum: a total over time, cumulative or per period (1).

members.name: Histogram
members.summary: A histogram with explicit bucket bounds (2).

members.name: ExponentialHistogram
members.summary: A histogram with exponentially sized buckets (3).

enums.name: CepRuleWindowType
enums.summary: The kind of time window an event processing rule collects events in (<c>CCepRuleHelper::WINDOW_*</c>, <c>CCepRuleHelper.php</c>).

members.name: None
members.summary: No window: the rule acts on each event as it occurs (0).

members.name: SimpleMultiple
members.summary: A simple window that an event joins in every rule of this kind it matches (1, "Simple (multiple)").

members.name: CauseSymptom
members.summary: A window that groups events as one cause and its symptoms; an event joins only the first rule of this kind it matches (2).

members.name: SimpleOnce
members.summary: A simple window that an event joins only in the first rule of this kind it matches, in rule order (3, "Simple (once)"; the server's <c>ZBX_CEP_WINDOW_CORRELATION</c>).

members.name: PatternMatch
members.summary: A window whose JavaScript decides when the events in it match a pattern (4).

enums.name: GraphItemType
enums.summary: The role of an item in a graph.

members.name: Simple
members.summary: The item is drawn as one of the graph's items.

members.name: Sum
members.summary: The item is the graph sum of a pie or exploded graph.

enums.name: GraphYAxisSide
enums.summary: Which Y axis of a graph an item is drawn against.

members.name: Left
members.summary: The item is drawn against the left Y axis.

members.name: Right
members.summary: The item is drawn against the right Y axis.

enums.name: GraphYAxisType
enums.summary: How a graph sets the minimum or maximum of its Y axis.

members.name: Calculated
members.summary: The axis limit is calculated from the values drawn.

members.name: Fixed
members.summary: The axis limit is the fixed value the graph sets.

members.name: ItemValue
members.summary: The axis limit is an item's last value.

enums.name: TlsAcceptModes
enums.summary: The connections a host or proxy accepts: a set of <c>HOST_ENCRYPTION_*</c> bits.

members.name: None
members.summary: No rule: any password the minimum length allows (<c>passwd_check_rules</c> 0, <c>CAuthentication.php</c>).

enums.name: PermissionLevel
enums.summary: An access level (<c>PERM_*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>): what a user group has to a host or template group, what a user or user group has to a shared dashboard or map, and the host permission a script needs.

enums.name: SnmpVersion
enums.summary: The SNMP version of an interface (<c>SNMP_V*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>).

members.name: V1
members.summary: SNMPv1 (1).

members.name: V2c
members.summary: SNMPv2c (2).

members.name: V3
members.summary: SNMPv3 (3).

enums.name: MapElementAreaType
enums.summary: How a map element that shows a host group's hosts sizes the area they are placed in.

members.name: Fit
members.summary: The host group's hosts are placed over the whole map.

members.name: Custom
members.summary: The host group's hosts are placed in an area of the size the element sets.

enums.name: MapElementSubtype
enums.summary: Whether a map element shows a host group as one icon or each of its hosts.

members.name: HostGroup
members.summary: The element shows the host group as one icon.

members.name: HostGroupElements
members.summary: The element shows each host of the host group as an icon of its own.

enums.name: TemplateLinkType
enums.summary: How a template was linked to a host: by a user or by low-level discovery.

members.name: Manual
members.summary: The template was linked by a user or through the API.

members.name: Lld
members.summary: The template was linked by low-level discovery.

enums.name: DisableSource
enums.summary: What disabled an object: a user or low-level discovery.

members.name: Default
members.summary: A user disabled the object, or it is in its default state.

members.name: Lld
members.summary: Low-level discovery disabled the object.

enums.name: EventOrigin
enums.summary: <c>ZBX_EVENT_*</c> (the server's <c>cep/zbx_cep.h</c>): how the server created an event.

members.name: Normal
members.summary: The server created the event from its source.

members.name: Copied
members.summary: Event processing created the event as a copy of another event.

enums.name: DiscoveryKinds
enums.summary: What discovery made of an object: the <c>ZBX_FLAG_DISCOVERY_*</c> bits (<c>defines.inc.php</c>): a discovery rule (1), a prototype (2), created by discovery (4); from 7.4 also their combinations, a rule prototype (3), a discovered rule (5), a discovered prototype (6) and a discovered rule prototype (7).

enums.name: DiscoveryState
enums.summary: Whether the last low-level discovery run still found a discovered object.

members.name: Discovered
members.summary: The last discovery run found the object.

members.name: Lost
members.summary: The last discovery run no longer found the object.

enums.name: EventActions
enums.summary: What a problem update did: a set of <c>ZBX_PROBLEM_UPDATE_*</c> bits.

enums.name: ServiceStatus
enums.summary: A service status: <c>ZBX_SEVERITY_OK</c> (-1) or the severity of the problem it is in (<c>TRIGGER_SEVERITY_*</c>), which is what <c>CService.php</c> stores and propagates (7.0:1102-1130); not <c>SERVICE_STATUS_*</c>, which only the frontend's filter uses.

enums.name: TagOrigin
enums.summary: Who created a tag: a user or low-level discovery.

members.name: Manual
members.summary: The tag was set by a user or through the API.

members.name: Automatic
members.summary: The tag was created by low-level discovery.

enums.name: TaskType
enums.summary: The type of a task (<c>ZBX_TM_*</c>, <c>defines.inc.php</c>): <c>task.create</c> takes the first three, and <c>task.get</c> returns data tasks only.

members.name: DiagnosticInformation
members.summary: Collect diagnostic information from the server or a proxy (1).

members.name: ProxyConfigurationReload
members.summary: Reload the configuration of the given proxies (2).

members.name: CheckNow
members.summary: Check the given item or discovery rule now (6).

members.name: Data
members.summary: A task holding a request and its result, the only type <c>task.get</c> returns (7).

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: The unique name of the action.

fields.name: EventSource
fields.summary: The type of event the action handles: trigger, discovery, autoregistration, internal or service events.

fields.name: Status
fields.summary: Enabled/disabled status. Wire field status. Left out, the server stores <c>ACTION_STATUS_ENABLED</c> (the <c>actions.status</c> default).

fields.name: EscalationPeriod
fields.summary: The default duration of an escalation step, as a time unit from 60 seconds to 1 week; applies to trigger, internal and service actions. The default is 1h.

fields.name: PauseSymptoms
fields.summary: Whether escalations are paused for symptom problems; applies only to trigger actions. The default is true.

fields.name: PauseSuppressed
fields.summary: Whether escalations are paused while the problem is suppressed; applies only to trigger actions. The default is true.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: The conditions that decide which events the action handles and how they combine.

fields.name: Operations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when a problem or other event occurs.

fields.name: RecoveryOperations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is resolved; applies to trigger, internal and service actions.

fields.name: UpdateOperations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is updated; applies to trigger and service actions.

fields.name: NotifyIfCanceled
fields.summary: Whether users are notified when an escalation is canceled; applies only to trigger actions. The default is true.

fields.name: FormulaId
fields.summary: Arbitrary unique identifier, such as a capital letter, that refers to this condition from a custom filter expression; required only when the filter uses a custom expression.

fields.name: Conditiontype
fields.summary: Kind of property the condition tests, such as host group, host, trigger, event severity, event tag, or time period.

fields.name: Operator
fields.summary: How the property is compared with the condition value, for example equals, does not equal, contains, or is in a time period; the allowed operators depend on the condition type.

fields.name: Value
fields.summary: Value the property is compared with, such as an object ID, a severity number, a tag name, or a time period, depending on the condition type.

fields.name: Value2
fields.summary: Secondary value used by conditions that compare two things; for an event tag value condition it holds the tag name while the value holds the tag value.

fields.name: Evaltype
fields.summary: How the filter conditions combine: and/or (conditions of the same type are joined with or, different types with and), all must match, any must match, or a custom expression given in the formula.

fields.name: Formula
fields.summary: Custom expression that combines the conditions by their formula IDs, such as "A and (B or C)"; required when the evaluation type is a custom expression and ignored otherwise.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.summary: Conditions the event must satisfy for the action to run; every condition used by a custom expression must carry a formula ID.

types.name: ActionGetParameters
types.summary: Query parameters for the action .get API method.

fields.name: GroupIds
fields.summary: Return only actions whose conditions refer to the given host groups.

fields.name: HostIds
fields.summary: Return only actions whose conditions refer to the given hosts.

fields.name: ActionIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to the actions whose IDs are listed.

fields.name: TriggerIds
fields.summary: Return only actions whose conditions refer to the given triggers.

fields.name: MediaTypeIds
fields.summary: Return only actions that send messages through the given media types.

fields.name: UserGroupIds
fields.summary: Keeps actions whose messages go to any of the listed user groups.

fields.name: UserIds
fields.summary: Keeps actions whose messages go to any of the listed users.

fields.name: ScriptIds
fields.summary: Return only actions that run the given scripts.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only actions whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only actions whose string properties match the given patterns; by default a property matches when it contains the text, without regard to case.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return actions that match any of the search patterns instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, a search pattern matches only at the start of the property value instead of anywhere in it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return actions that do not match the search patterns.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search pattern matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: The action properties to return, either as a list of property names or as extend for all of them; extend is the default.

fields.name: SelectFilter
fields.summary: Return the condition filter of each action in the filter property.

fields.name: SelectOperations
fields.summary: Return the operations of each action in the operations property.

fields.name: SelectRecoveryOperations
fields.summary: Return the recovery operations of each action in the recovery_operations property.

fields.name: SelectUpdateOperations
fields.summary: Return the update operations of each action in the update_operations property.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching actions instead of the records.

fields.name: PreserveKeys
fields.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by action ID instead of an array.

fields.name: SortField
fields.summary: The properties to sort actions by; accepted values are actionid, name and status.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.summary: The direction for each sort property: ASC for ascending, the default, or DESC for descending.

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: The maximum number of actions to return.

fields.name: GroupId
fields.summary: The ID of a host group whose hosts run the script.

fields.summary: The ID of a host that runs the script; 0 runs it on the host that generated the event.

fields.name: Conditiontype
fields.summary: Type of the operation condition; operations support only the condition that tests whether the event is acknowledged.

fields.name: Value
fields.summary: Value the condition tests: "1" for an acknowledged event, "0" for an unacknowledged one.

fields.name: Operator
fields.summary: Comparison applied to the value; operation conditions accept only the equals operator.

fields.name: GroupId
fields.summary: The ID of a host group that the operation adds the host to or removes it from.

fields.name: InventoryMode
fields.summary: The inventory mode that the operation sets on the host.

fields.summary: ID of a user group whose members receive the message.

fields.summary: Whether to use the default subject and message from the media type message templates; when true, the subject and message given here are ignored.

fields.name: Subject
fields.summary: The subject of the message; used only when the default message is not used.

fields.name: Message
fields.summary: The text of the message; used only when the default message is not used.

fields.name: MediatypeId
fields.summary: Media type for delivery, by ID. Use 0 to deliver through every media type.

fields.name: UserId
fields.summary: ID of a user who receives the message.

fields.name: Tag
fields.summary: Name of the host tag that the operation adds to or removes from the host.

fields.name: Value
fields.summary: Value of the host tag that the operation adds or removes; empty when the tag has no value.

fields.name: TemplateId
fields.summary: ID of a template to link to, or unlink from, the host.

fields.name: Operationtype
fields.summary: Kind of operation to perform, such as sending a message, running a script, adding or removing a host, changing host groups or templates, or setting the host inventory mode; the allowed kinds depend on the action event source.

fields.name: EscPeriod
fields.summary: Duration of this escalation step, as a time unit with an optional suffix from 60 seconds to 1 week or a user macro; 0 uses the default step duration of the action.

fields.name: EscStepFrom
fields.summary: Escalation step at which the operation starts, from 1 to 99999; the server uses 1 when omitted.

fields.name: EscStepTo
fields.summary: Escalation step at which the operation ends, from 0 to 99999, where 0 repeats the operation for every following step; the server uses 1 when omitted.

fields.name: Evaltype
fields.summary: How the operation conditions are combined: and/or, and, or or. Applies only to operations of trigger actions.

fields.name: Opconditions
fields.summary: Conditions that must be met for the operation to run, such as whether the event is acknowledged; supported only for operations of trigger actions.

fields.name: Opmessage
fields.summary: Message to send, including its subject, body, and media type; required when the operation sends a message.

fields.name: OpmessageGrp
fields.summary: User groups whose members receive the message.

fields.name: OpmessageUsr
fields.summary: Users who receive the message.

fields.name: Opcommand
fields.summary: Script to run; required when the operation runs a script.

fields.name: OpcommandGrp
fields.summary: Host groups on whose hosts the script runs.

fields.name: OpcommandHst
fields.summary: Hosts on which the script runs; a host ID of 0 runs the script on the current host.

fields.name: Opgroup
fields.summary: Host groups the host is added to or removed from; required for operations that change host group membership.

fields.name: Optemplate
fields.summary: Templates linked to or unlinked from the host; required for operations that link or unlink templates.

fields.name: Opinventory
fields.summary: Inventory mode to set on the host; required for operations that change the inventory mode.

fields.name: Optag
fields.summary: Tags added to or removed from the host by the operation.

fields.summary: Whether escalations are paused while the problem is suppressed; applies only to trigger actions.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: The conditions that decide which events the action handles and how they combine.

fields.name: Operations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when a problem or other event occurs.

fields.name: RecoveryOperations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is resolved; applies to trigger, internal and service actions.

fields.name: UpdateOperations
fields.summary: The operations the action runs when the problem is updated; applies to trigger and service actions.

fields.name: NotifyIfCanceled
fields.summary: Whether users are notified when an escalation is canceled; applies only to trigger actions.

types.name: Alert
types.summary: The alert read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

fields.name: AlertId
fields.summary: ID of the alert.

fields.name: ActionId
fields.summary: The action that produced the alert, by ID.

fields.name: EventId
fields.summary: ID of the event that generated the alert.

fields.name: UserId
fields.summary: The recipient user of the message, by ID.

fields.name: Clock
fields.summary: Time the alert was generated, as a Unix timestamp.

fields.name: MediaTypeId
fields.summary: The media type that delivered the message, by ID.

fields.name: SendTo
fields.summary: Address, user name or other recipient identifier the message was sent to. Applies to message alerts.

fields.name: Subject
fields.summary: Subject of the message. Applies to message alerts.

fields.name: Message
fields.summary: Body of the message. Applies to message alerts.

fields.name: Status
fields.summary: Whether the alert went out: not sent yet, sent, failed, or new (<c>ALERT_STATUS_*</c>).

fields.name: Retries
fields.summary: How many delivery attempts Zabbix made for the message.

fields.name: Error
fields.summary: Why sending the alert failed; empty when it did not.

fields.name: EscStep
fields.summary: Escalation step of the action during which the alert was generated.

fields.name: AlertType
fields.summary: Whether the alert is a message or a remote command.

fields.name: PEventId
fields.summary: ID of the problem event, for an alert generated by its recovery or an update; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: AcknowledgeId
fields.summary: ID of the problem update that generated the alert, or 0 when the alert does not come from an update.

fields.name: Hosts
fields.summary: What <c>selectHosts</c> adds.

fields.name: Mediatypes
fields.summary: What <c>selectMediatypes</c> adds.

fields.name: Users
fields.summary: What <c>selectUsers</c> adds.

types.name: AlertGetParameters
types.summary: Query parameters for the alert .get API method.

fields.name: AlertIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to the alerts whose IDs are listed.

fields.name: GroupIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to alerts raised by objects in the listed host groups.

fields.name: HostIds
fields.summary: Keeps alerts whose originating objects sit on any of the listed hosts.

fields.name: ObjectIds
fields.summary: Keeps alerts whose source events came from the listed objects, for example triggers.

fields.name: ActionIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to alerts produced by any of the listed actions.

fields.name: EventIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to alerts raised by the listed events.

fields.name: MediaTypeIds
fields.summary: Return only message alerts sent through the given media types.

fields.name: UserIds
fields.summary: Keeps message alerts whose recipient is one of the listed users.

fields.name: Eventsource
fields.summary: Keeps alerts raised by events from this source; trigger events unless set.

fields.name: Eventobject
fields.summary: Keeps alerts whose source events concern the given object type; triggers unless set.

fields.name: TimeFrom
fields.summary: Return only alerts generated strictly after the given Unix timestamp.

fields.name: TimeTo
fields.summary: Return only alerts generated strictly before the given Unix timestamp.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: The alert properties to return: a list of property names, or extend for all of them. The object ID is always included. Defaults to extend.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: If true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: GroupCount
fields.summary: Together with count output and an event filter, return one count per event instead of a single total.

fields.name: SelectHosts
fields.summary: Return a hosts property with the hosts whose events triggered the action operation.

fields.name: SelectMediaTypes
fields.summary: Return a mediatypes property with the media types used for the message alert.

fields.name: SelectUsers
fields.summary: Adds the message recipients under `users`.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Exact-match filter: an object whose keys are alert properties and whose values are a single value or an array of accepted values. Text-type properties are not supported.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Case-insensitive pattern search: an object whose keys are alert properties and whose values are substrings to look for. By default a value matches anywhere in the property.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: If true, return results that match any of the filter or search criteria rather than all of them. Defaults to false.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: If true, the search criteria match only at the beginning of a property value instead of anywhere in it. Ignored when wildcards are enabled.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: If true, return the results that do not match the search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: If true, an asterisk in a search value acts as a wildcard. Defaults to false.

fields.name: SortField
fields.summary: Properties to sort the result by. Allowed values: alertid, clock, eventid, mediatypeid, sendto, status. Without it the result is unsorted.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.summary: Sort direction, ascending or descending; when a list is given, each entry applies to the sort field at the same position. Defaults to ascending.

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

fields.name: Editable
fields.summary: If true, return only alerts the user has write permission to. Defaults to false.

fields.name: PreserveKeys
fields.summary: If true, key the result by object ID instead of returning a plain array.

types.name: ApmLog
types.summary: An OpenTelemetry log record that Zabbix stores for application performance monitoring, as <c>apmlog.get</c> returns it.

fields.name: Timestamp
fields.summary: Time the log record was observed, as text with nanoseconds (<c>YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.nnnnnnnnn</c>, UTC).

fields.name: TraceId
fields.summary: ID of the trace the log record belongs to, as hexadecimal text; empty when the record is not part of a trace.

fields.name: SpanId
fields.summary: ID of the span the log record belongs to, as hexadecimal text; empty when the record is not part of a span.

fields.name: TraceFlags
fields.summary: W3C trace flags of the trace context the record was written in; bit 1 marks a sampled trace.

fields.name: SeverityText
fields.summary: Severity of the record as its source names it, such as INFO or ERROR.

fields.name: SeverityNumber
fields.summary: Severity of the record as an OpenTelemetry severity number, from 1 (TRACE) to 24 (FATAL4); 0 when unspecified.

fields.name: ServiceName
fields.summary: Name of the service that wrote the record (the <c>service.name</c> resource attribute).

fields.name: Body
fields.summary: Body of the log record, the message itself.

fields.name: ResourceSchemaUrl
fields.summary: Schema URL of the resource attributes.

fields.name: ResourceAttributes
fields.summary: Attributes of the resource that wrote the record, by key.

fields.name: ScopeSchemaUrl
fields.summary: Schema URL of the instrumentation scope.

fields.name: ScopeName
fields.summary: Name of the instrumentation scope that wrote the record.

fields.name: ScopeVersion
fields.summary: Version of the instrumentation scope that wrote the record.

fields.name: ScopeAttributes
fields.summary: Attributes of the instrumentation scope, by key.

fields.name: LogAttributes
fields.summary: Attributes of the log record itself, by key.

fields.name: EventName
fields.summary: Name of the event the record describes; empty when it describes none.

fields.name: TimeFrom

fields.name: TimeTo
fields.summary: Return only log records before the given Unix time. Required.

fields.name: TraceIds
fields.summary: Return only log records of the given traces.

fields.name: SpanIds

fields.summary: Return only log records whose trace flags have every bit of the given mask set.

fields.name: WithFlagsOff

fields.name: SeverityNumbers
fields.summary: Return only log records of the given OpenTelemetry severity numbers, from 1 to 24.

fields.name: ResourceAttributes
fields.summary: Return only log records whose resource attributes match the given conditions.

fields.name: ResourceAttributesEvaltype
fields.summary: How the resource attribute conditions combine: <c>AndOr</c> (the default) combines conditions on the same key with or and the rest with and; <c>Or</c> combines all of them with or.

fields.name: ScopeAttributes
fields.summary: Return only log records whose scope attributes match the given conditions.

fields.name: ScopeAttributesEvaltype
fields.summary: How the scope attribute conditions combine: <c>AndOr</c> (the default) combines conditions on the same key with or and the rest with and; <c>Or</c> combines all of them with or.

fields.name: LogAttributes
fields.summary: Return only log records whose own attributes match the given conditions.

fields.name: LogAttributesEvaltype
fields.summary: How the log attribute conditions combine: <c>AndOr</c> (the default) combines conditions on the same key with or and the rest with and; <c>Or</c> combines all of them with or.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only log records whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only log records whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, a Search value matches only at the start of a property instead of anywhere in it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: Properties to return for each of the log records; when omitted, all properties are returned.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: Sortfield
fields.summary: Properties to sort the results by; accepted values are timestamp, traceid, spanid, trace_flags, severity_text, severity_number, service_name, resource_schema_url, scope_schema_url, scope_name, scope_version and event_name.

fields.name: Sortorder
fields.summary: Sort direction for each sort field, ASC (the default) or DESC.

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

fields.name: Offset
fields.summary: Number of matching records to skip before the first one returned.

fields.summary: Value of a gauge or sum point.

fields.name: Max

fields.name: Scale

fields.name: ZeroCount

fields.name: PositiveOffset
fields.summary: Index of the first positive bucket of an exponential histogram point.

fields.name: PositiveBucketCounts

fields.name: NegativeOffset

fields.name: NegativeBucketCounts

fields.name: TimeFrom

fields.name: TimeTo
fields.summary: Return only traces before the given Unix time. Required.

fields.summary: Return only traces with a span whose resource attributes match the given conditions.

fields.name: SpanAttributesEvaltype

fields.name: MaxDuration

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only traces whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only traces whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, a Search value matches only at the start of a property instead of anywhere in it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: Sortfield

fields.name: Sortorder

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

fields.name: Offset

fields.name: Filter

fields.name: Window
fields.summary: Settings of the time window, such as its duration, capacity and event grouping; required for cause and symptom and pattern match windows.

fields.name: Operations
fields.summary: Operations the rule performs on the events, each with an order and the moment it runs; required for every window type except cause and symptom.

fields.name: Stop
fields.summary: Whether processing continues with the following rules after this rule is applied or stops at this rule. Defaults to continue.

fields.name: Position
fields.summary: Position of the rule in the processing order, from 0 to 2147483647. Required.

fields.name: Description

fields.name: Evaltype
fields.summary: How the filter conditions combine: 0 and/or, 1 and, 2 or, 3 custom expression.

fields.name: EvalFormula
fields.summary: Expression the server evaluates, generated from the conditions and the evaluation type.

fields.name: Formula
fields.summary: Custom expression that combines the conditions by their formula IDs; empty unless the evaluation type is a custom expression.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.summary: Conditions an event must satisfy for the rule to process it, such as event name, tag, tag value, severity, host name, host group name or time period.

fields.name: FormulaId

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: Kind of event property the condition tests: event name, tag, tag value, severity, host visible name, host group name, or time period.

fields.name: Operator
fields.summary: How the property is compared with the condition value; the allowed operators depend on the condition type, for example in or not in for a time period condition.

fields.name: EventName
fields.summary: Event name to compare with; required and accepted only for event name conditions.

fields.name: Tag
fields.summary: Tag name to compare with; required for tag and tag value conditions.

fields.name: TagValue
fields.summary: Tag value to compare with; accepted only for tag value conditions.

fields.name: Severity
fields.summary: Severity to compare with; required and accepted only for severity conditions.

fields.name: HostName
fields.summary: Host visible name to compare with; required and accepted only for host visible name conditions.

fields.name: HostGroupName
fields.summary: Host group name to compare with; required and accepted only for host group name conditions.

fields.name: TimePeriod
fields.summary: Time period in the Zabbix time period format, such as 1-5,09:00-18:00; required and accepted only for time period conditions.

fields.name: Evaltype
fields.summary: How the filter conditions combine: and/or, all must match, any must match, or a custom expression given in the formula.

fields.name: Formula
fields.summary: Custom expression that combines the conditions by their formula IDs; required when the evaluation type is a custom expression.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.summary: Conditions an event must satisfy for the rule to process it, such as event name, tag, tag value, severity, host name, host group name or time period.

fields.summary: Return only event processing rules with the given IDs.

fields.name: Filter

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only results whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, the Search values must match the start of the property rather than any part of it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: Properties to return for each result; when omitted, all properties are returned.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: SelectWindow

fields.name: SelectOperations

fields.name: Sortfield
fields.summary: Properties to sort the results by; only the properties this method supports for sorting are accepted.

fields.name: Position
fields.summary: Sort direction for each sort field, ASC (the default) or DESC.

fields.name: Limit

fields.name: Editable

fields.name: Preservekeys
fields.summary: When true, return the results as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

fields.name: Position
fields.summary: The position of the operation in the execution order of the rule; unique within the rule.

fields.name: ExecuteWhen
fields.summary: When the operation runs: 0 when an event occurs, 1 when an event is added to the window, 2 when an event is evicted from the window, 3 when the window closes, 4 when the pattern is matched. The allowed values depend on the window type of the rule.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: The conditions that an event must meet for the operation to run, with their evaluation type and formula.

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: The action that the operation performs: 1 set the event name, 2 close the event, 3 discard the event, 4 set severity, 5 increase severity, 6 decrease severity, 7 suppress, 8 unsuppress, 9 clone the first event, 10 clone the last event, 11 add a tag, 12 set a tag, 13 set a tag value, 14 increase a tag value, 15 decrease a tag value, 16 rename a tag, 17 remove a tag, 18 close the window, 19 set the event as cause.

fields.name: EventName
fields.summary: The new event name; required when the operation sets the event name and empty otherwise.

fields.name: Severity
fields.summary: The severity that the operation sets; used only when the operation sets severity.

fields.name: SuppressDuration
fields.summary: How long the operation suppresses the event, as a time unit of up to five years; 0 suppresses it indefinitely. Used only by suppress operations.

fields.name: Tag
fields.summary: The name of the tag that the operation adds, sets, changes, renames or removes; required by tag operations and empty otherwise.

fields.name: NewTag
fields.summary: The new tag name; required when the operation renames a tag and empty otherwise.

fields.name: TagValue
fields.summary: The tag value that the operation adds or sets; used when the operation adds a tag, sets a tag, or sets a tag value.

fields.name: FormulaId
fields.summary: Letter that identifies the condition in a custom filter expression; required only when the filter uses a custom expression.

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: Type of the condition: event tag, event tag value, or whether the event is open, the first, the last, a symptom, a copy, or suppressed.

fields.name: Operator
fields.summary: Comparison the condition applies: equals, does not equal, contains or does not contain for tags; those plus greater than or equal and less than or equal for tag values; yes or no for the event state conditions.

fields.name: Tag
fields.summary: Name of the event tag that the condition tests; required for tag and tag value conditions.

fields.name: TagValue
fields.summary: Tag value that the condition compares; used only by tag value conditions and must not be empty for contains, does not contain and the range operators.

fields.name: Evaltype
fields.summary: How the filter conditions are combined: and/or, and, or, or a custom expression.

fields.name: Formula
fields.summary: Custom filter expression that combines the conditions by their formula IDs; required when the filter uses a custom expression.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.summary: Conditions an event must meet for the operation to apply.

fields.name: Position
fields.summary: Position of the operation in the rule; operations must be ordered by their execution moment.

fields.name: ExecuteWhen
fields.summary: When the operation runs: 0 when the event occurs, 1 when the event is added to the window, 2 when it is evicted from the window, 3 when the window closes, 4 when the pattern matches. The moments allowed depend on the rule's window type.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Conditions that decide whether the operation applies to the event.

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: Operation to perform: 1 set name, 2 close event, 3 discard, 4 set severity, 5 increase severity, 6 decrease severity, 7 suppress, 8 unsuppress, 9 clone first, 10 clone last, 11 add tag, 12 set tag, 13 set tag value, 14 increase tag value, 15 decrease tag value, 16 rename tag, 17 remove tag, 18 close window, 19 set cause.

fields.name: EventName
fields.summary: New event name; required for the set name operation and empty otherwise.

fields.name: Severity
fields.summary: Severity to assign; required for the set severity operation.

fields.name: SuppressDuration
fields.summary: How long the event stays suppressed, as seconds or a time suffix up to five years; required for the suppress operation.

fields.name: Tag
fields.summary: Name of the tag the operation works on; required for the tag operations.

fields.name: NewTag
fields.summary: New name for the tag; required for the rename tag operation.

fields.name: TagValue
fields.summary: Tag value to write; required for the add tag, set tag and set tag value operations.

fields.summary: ID of the event processing rule whose time windows the server resets. Required.

fields.summary: When true, return only LLD rule prototypes inherited from a template; when false, only those that are not inherited.

fields.summary: When true, return only enabled LLD rule prototypes on monitored hosts; when false, only the others.

fields.name: Editable
fields.summary: When true, return only LLD rule prototypes that the user has write permission on.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only LLD rule prototypes whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values. The additional key host matches the technical name of the owning host.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only LLD rule prototypes whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.summary: Properties of the LLD rule prototypes to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

fields.name: SelectTriggers

fields.name: SelectGraphs

fields.name: SelectHostPrototypes

fields.summary: What happens to discovered entities that the rule no longer finds: deleted after the lifetime period, never deleted, or deleted immediately. Defaults to deleting after the lifetime period.

fields.name: Uuid
fields.summary: Universally unique identifier of the discovery rule, which matches it to the same discovery rule when a configuration is exported and imported.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: The discovery rule's visible label.

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: How the server collects the discovery data, for example Zabbix agent, SNMP agent, HTTP agent, script or dependent item.

fields.name: Key
fields.summary: Item key of the discovery rule; it must be unique on the host or template.

fields.name: Lifetime
fields.summary: How long entities that are no longer discovered are kept before deletion, as a time unit of 0 or from 1 hour to 25 years with user macros allowed; used only when entities are deleted after the lifetime period. Defaults to 7d.

fields.name: EnabledLifetimeType
fields.summary: What happens to entities that are no longer discovered while they await deletion: disabled after the enabled lifetime period, never disabled, or disabled immediately. Not used when entities are deleted immediately; defaults to disabling immediately.

fields.name: EnabledLifetime
fields.summary: How long entities that are no longer discovered stay enabled before they are disabled, as a time unit of 0 or from 1 hour to 25 years with user macros allowed; used only when they are disabled after the period, and must be shorter than Lifetime.

fields.name: Description
fields.summary: Description of the discovery rule.

fields.name: Status
fields.summary: Controls whether the rule is active. Disabled rules are skipped.

fields.name: Preprocessing
fields.summary: Preprocessing steps applied to the discovery data; replaces the existing ones.

fields.name: LldMacroPaths
fields.summary: LLD macros and the JSONPath expressions that extract their values from the discovered data; replaces the existing ones.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Filter that discovered rows must pass; replaces the existing filter.

fields.name: Overrides
fields.summary: Overrides that change the attributes of discovered entities that match their filters; replaces the existing ones.

fields.name: Parameters
fields.summary: Parameters, as name and value pairs, passed to the script of script and browser rules.

fields.name: Params
fields.summary: Parameters of the item type: the formula of a calculated item, the SQL query of a database monitor item, the script of an SSH, Telnet or script item.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.summary: Timeout for collecting the data, as a time unit from 1 to 600 seconds with user macros allowed; empty uses the proxy or global timeout for the rule type.

fields.name: Delay
fields.summary: Update interval, as a time unit with a suffix (30s, 1m) or a user macro, optionally followed by custom flexible and scheduling intervals separated by semicolons.

fields.name: Username
fields.summary: User name for authentication, used by SSH agent, Telnet agent, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

fields.name: Password
fields.summary: Password for authentication, used by SSH agent, Telnet agent, database monitor, JMX agent and HTTP agent rules.

fields.name: MasterItemId
fields.summary: ID of the master item whose value a dependent discovery rule processes; required for dependent rules.

fields.name: InterfaceId
fields.summary: ID of the host interface the discovery rule is polled through; 0 for a type that uses no interface.

fields.name: Url
fields.summary: URL that HTTP agent rules request; required for that type.

fields.name: QueryFields
fields.summary: Query parameters, as name and value pairs, that HTTP agent rules append to the URL.

fields.name: RequestMethod
fields.summary: HTTP method that HTTP agent rules use: GET, POST, PUT or HEAD. Defaults to GET.

fields.name: PostType
fields.summary: Format of the request body that HTTP agent rules send: raw data, JSON or XML. Defaults to raw data.

fields.name: Posts
fields.summary: Request body that HTTP agent rules send; required when the body type is JSON or XML.

fields.name: Headers
fields.summary: HTTP headers, as name and value pairs, that HTTP agent rules send with the request.

fields.name: StatusCodes
fields.summary: HTTP status codes that HTTP agent rules accept as success, as a comma-separated list of codes and ranges with user macros allowed. Defaults to 200.

fields.name: FollowRedirects
fields.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules follow HTTP redirects. Defaults to true.

fields.name: RetrieveMode
fields.summary: Which part of the HTTP response HTTP agent rules store: the body, the headers, or both. HEAD requests can store only the headers. Defaults to the body.

fields.name: OutputFormat
fields.summary: How HTTP agent rules store the response: as received, or converted to JSON. Defaults to as received.

fields.name: HttpProxy
fields.summary: HTTP proxy that HTTP agent rules connect through, in the form [protocol://][user[:password]@]host[:port].

fields.name: AuthType
fields.summary: Authentication method. For SSH agent rules: 0 password, 1 public key. For HTTP agent rules: 0 none, 1 basic, 2 NTLM, 3 Kerberos, 4 Digest. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: VerifyPeer
fields.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules verify the certificate of the web server. Defaults to false.

fields.name: VerifyHost
fields.summary: Whether HTTP agent rules verify that the host name in the URL matches the server certificate. Defaults to false.

fields.name: SslCertFile
fields.summary: Path to the public SSL key file that HTTP agent rules use for client authentication.

fields.name: SslKeyFile
fields.summary: Path to the private SSL key file that HTTP agent rules use for client authentication.

fields.name: SslKeyPassword
fields.summary: Password for the private SSL key file used by HTTP agent rules.

fields.name: AllowTraps
fields.summary: Whether an HTTP agent rule also accepts data sent to it as a trapper. Defaults to false.

fields.name: TrapperHosts
fields.summary: Comma-separated IP addresses, CIDR ranges or DNS names allowed to send data to Zabbix trapper rules and HTTP agent rules that accept traps; empty accepts any sender.

fields.name: IpmiSensor
fields.summary: IPMI sensor that IPMI agent rules read.

fields.name: JmxEndpoint
fields.summary: JMX endpoint URL that JMX agent rules connect to; defaults to service:jmx:rmi:///jndi/rmi://{HOST.CONN}:{HOST.PORT}/jmxrmi.

fields.name: SnmpOid
fields.summary: SNMP OID or SNMP request that SNMP agent rules query; required for that type.

fields.name: PublicKey
fields.summary: Name of the public key file used by SSH agent rules with public key authentication.

fields.name: PrivateKey
fields.summary: Name of the private key file used by SSH agent rules with public key authentication.

types.name: Event
types.summary: The event read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

fields.name: EventId
fields.summary: ID of the event.

fields.name: Source
fields.summary: What created the event: a trigger, network discovery, active agent autoregistration, an internal state change, or a service status update.

fields.name: ObjectType
fields.summary: Type of object the event is related to (<c>EVENT_OBJECT_*</c>).

fields.name: ObjectId
fields.summary: ID of the object that created the event; the kind of object depends on the event source.

fields.name: Clock
fields.summary: Time the event was created, as a Unix timestamp.

fields.name: Value
fields.summary: State the event records, which depends on the source: OK or problem for trigger and service events; up, down, discovered or lost for discovery events; normal or unknown/not supported for internal events.

fields.name: Acknowledged
fields.summary: Whether the event is acknowledged.

fields.name: Ns
fields.summary: Nanoseconds of the time the event was created.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: Resolved name of the event.

fields.name: Severity
fields.summary: Current severity of the event, from not classified to disaster.

fields.name: RecoveryEventId
fields.summary: ID of the recovery event that resolved this problem event.

fields.name: ClosingEventId
fields.summary: ID of the event that closed this problem under a global correlation rule; set only when a correlation rule closed it.

fields.name: CorrelationId
fields.summary: ID of the global correlation rule that closed the problem; set only when a correlation rule closed it.

fields.name: UserId
fields.summary: For a manually closed problem, the closing user, by ID.

fields.name: CauseEventId
fields.summary: ID of the cause event, when this event is a symptom of another event.

fields.name: Opdata
fields.summary: Operational data of the event with macros expanded.

fields.name: Suppressed
fields.summary: Indicates suppression of the event, either manual or through maintenance.

fields.name: Urls
fields.summary: Names and URLs defined by active media types with an enabled event menu entry, with macros expanded.

fields.name: CepRuleId
fields.summary: ID of the complex event processing rule that closed the problem, when such a rule closed it.

fields.name: Flags
fields.summary: How the server created the event: 0 from its source, 1 as a copy of another event that event processing made (<c>ZBX_EVENT_NORMAL</c>, <c>ZBX_EVENT_COPIED</c> in the server's <c>cep/zbx_cep.h</c>).

fields.name: RelatedObject
fields.summary: What <c>selectRelatedObject</c> adds.

fields.name: SuppressionData
fields.summary: Maintenance-suppression entries (returned by selectSuppressionData). Previously dropped on read even when EventGetParameters.SelectSuppressionData requested it.

fields.name: Acknowledges
fields.summary: Updates made to the event, such as acknowledgements, messages, severity changes and suppression, newest first; returned when selectAcknowledges is requested.

fields.name: Alerts
fields.summary: What <c>selectAlerts</c> adds.

fields.name: Hosts
fields.summary: Hosts that contain the object that created the event; returned when selectHosts is requested.

fields.name: Tags
fields.summary: Tags of the event; returned when selectTags is requested.

fields.name: AcknowledgeId
fields.summary: ID of the problem update.

fields.name: UserId
fields.summary: ID of the user who made the update.

fields.name: Clock
fields.summary: Time of the update, as a Unix timestamp.

fields.name: Message
fields.summary: Message text left with the update.

fields.name: Action
fields.summary: Actions performed by the update, combined as flags, such as close, acknowledge, add message, change severity, suppress or change rank.

fields.name: OldSeverity
fields.summary: Severity of the event before the update.

fields.name: NewSeverity
fields.summary: Severity of the event after the update.

fields.name: SuppressUntil
fields.summary: Time until which the update suppresses the event, as a Unix timestamp; 0 means indefinitely.

fields.name: TaskId
fields.summary: ID of the server task created to apply the update, if any.

fields.name: Username
fields.summary: Username of the user who made the update.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: First name of the user who made the update.

fields.name: Surname
fields.summary: Last name of the user who made the update.

fields.name: MaintenanceId
fields.summary: ID of the maintenance that suppressed or unsuppressed the event, for updates made by maintenance.

fields.name: Details
fields.summary: JSON description of the changes that complex event processing rules made to the event; empty for other updates.

fields.name: CepRuleId
fields.summary: ID of the complex event processing rule that made the update, for updates made by such a rule.

fields.name: EventIds
fields.summary: IDs of the events to update.

fields.name: Action
fields.summary: Update actions to perform, combined as flags: close the problem, acknowledge, add a message, change severity, unacknowledge, suppress, unsuppress, and change the rank to cause or to symptom.

fields.name: Message
fields.summary: Text of the message to add; required when the action includes adding a message.

fields.name: Severity
fields.summary: New severity for the events; required when the action includes changing the severity.

fields.name: SuppressUntil
fields.summary: Unix time until which the events stay suppressed, or 0 to suppress them indefinitely; required when the action includes suppressing.

fields.name: CauseEventId
fields.summary: ID of the cause event; required when the action includes changing the rank to symptom.

types.name: EventGetParameters
types.summary: Query parameters for the event .get API method.

fields.name: EventIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to the events whose IDs are listed.

fields.name: GroupIds
fields.summary: Return only events created by objects on hosts in the given host groups.

fields.name: HostIds
fields.summary: Return only events created by objects on the given hosts.

fields.name: ObjectIds
fields.summary: Keeps events whose source is one of the listed objects.

fields.name: Source
fields.summary: Return only events from the given source; defaults to trigger events.

fields.name: ObjectType
fields.summary: Return only events of this type of object.

fields.name: Value
fields.summary: Keeps events whose value is in the list; what each value means varies by event source.

fields.name: Severities
fields.summary: Keeps events whose severity is in the list; trigger events only.

fields.name: TriggerSeverities
fields.summary: Return only events whose trigger has one of the given severities; applies to trigger events.

fields.name: EventIdFrom
fields.summary: Return only events whose ID is greater than or equal to the given ID.

fields.name: EventIdTo
fields.summary: Return only events whose ID is less than or equal to the given ID.

fields.name: TimeFrom
fields.summary: Keeps events whose creation time is no earlier than this Unix time.

fields.name: TimeTo
fields.summary: Keeps events whose creation time is no later than the given Unix time.

fields.name: ProblemTimeFrom
fields.summary: Return only events that were in the problem state at some point from the given Unix time on, regardless of their current state; applies to trigger events and requires problem_time_till.

fields.name: ProblemTimeTo
fields.summary: Return only events that were in the problem state at some point up to the given Unix time, regardless of their current state; applies to trigger events and requires problem_time_from.

fields.name: Acknowledged
fields.summary: When true, return only acknowledged events; when false, only unacknowledged ones.

fields.name: Action
fields.summary: Return only events with an update that performed all of the given update actions, combined as flags.

fields.name: ActionUserIds
fields.summary: Return only events updated by the given users.

fields.name: Suppressed
fields.summary: When true, return only suppressed events; when false, only events that are not suppressed.

fields.name: Symptom
fields.summary: When true, return only symptom events; when false, only cause events.

fields.name: EvalType
fields.summary: How the tag conditions combine: And/Or (the default), where conditions on the same tag name are joined with Or and different names with And, or Or, where any condition is enough.

fields.name: Tags
fields.summary: Filters events by tag conditions; each one pairs a tag name and value with an operator (contains, equals, does not contain, does not equal, exists or does not exist). With an empty list, no event is filtered out.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only events whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only events whose properties contain the given text; matching is case-insensitive and substring-based unless startSearch or searchWildcardsEnabled changes it.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return objects that match any of the search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, search values match only at the beginning of a property instead of anywhere in it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return the objects that do not match the search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: Properties of the events to return: a list of property names, or extend for all properties.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching events instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: GroupBy
fields.summary: Properties to group the result by, which are then returned in each row; objectid is the only supported value.

fields.name: SelectAcknowledgesAlias
fields.summary: The 7.0 spelling of <c>selectAcknowledges</c> (<see cref="SelectAcknowledges"/>): the same selection, deprecated in 7.0 (<c>API_DEPRECATED</c>) and refused from 7.4 (<c>CEvent.php</c>).

fields.name: SelectAcknowledges
fields.summary: Return an acknowledges property with the updates made to the event, newest first; supports count.

fields.name: SelectAlertsAlias
fields.summary: The 7.0 spelling of <c>selectAlerts</c> (<see cref="SelectAlerts"/>): the same selection, deprecated in 7.0 (<c>API_DEPRECATED</c>) and refused from 7.4 (<c>CEvent.php</c>).

fields.name: SelectAlerts
fields.summary: Adds the alerts the event produced under `alerts`, newest first.

fields.name: SelectHosts
fields.summary: Adds, under `hosts`, the hosts holding the event's source object. Works for trigger, item and LLD rule events.

fields.name: SelectRelatedObject
fields.summary: Adds the event's originating object under `relatedObject`. The event source determines what kind of object it is.

fields.name: SelectSuppressionData
fields.summary: Return a suppression_data property with the active maintenances and manual suppressions of the event.

fields.name: SelectTags
fields.summary: Return a tags property with the tags of the event.

fields.name: SortField
fields.summary: Properties to sort the result by; supported values are eventid, objectid and clock; with groupBy only objectid, and with countOutput and groupBy objectid and rowscount.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.summary: Sort direction for each sort field: ASC for ascending (the default) or DESC for descending.

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

fields.name: Editable
fields.summary: When true, return only events that the user has write permission on.

fields.name: PreserveKeys
fields.summary: When true, return the result as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

fields.name: EventSuppressId
fields.summary: The ID of the suppression record.

fields.name: EventId
fields.summary: ID of the suppressed event.

fields.name: MaintenanceId
fields.summary: The ID of the maintenance that suppressed the event; 0 when the event was not suppressed by maintenance.

fields.name: SuppressUntil
fields.summary: When the suppression ends, as a Unix timestamp; 0 means the event is suppressed indefinitely.

fields.name: UserId
fields.summary: The ID of the user who suppressed the event manually; 0 when it was not suppressed by a user.

fields.name: CepRuleId
fields.summary: The ID of the event processing rule that suppressed the event; 0 when it was not suppressed by a rule.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: The label of the link.

fields.name: Url
fields.summary: The address that the link opens, with macros resolved.

types.name: GeneratedToken
types.summary: A token <c>token.generate</c> generated: its id, and the secret the server answers only this once.

fields.name: TokenId
fields.summary: The token's id.

fields.name: Token
fields.summary: The token itself, to authenticate with. The server keeps only its hash, so it answers it only here.

types.name: Graph
types.summary: The graph read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.

fields.name: GraphId
fields.summary: ID of the graph.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: Name of the graph.

fields.name: Width
fields.summary: Graph width, in pixels; 900 unless set.

fields.name: Height
fields.summary: Graph height, in pixels; 200 unless set.

fields.name: YAxisMin
fields.summary: Fixed minimum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymin_type</c> is fixed.

fields.name: YAxisMax
fields.summary: Fixed maximum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymax_type</c> is fixed.

fields.name: TemplateId
fields.summary: ID of the graph in the template it was inherited from; 0 when it was not inherited.

fields.name: ShowWorkPeriod
fields.summary: Whether the graph highlights the working time: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: ShowTriggers
fields.summary: Whether the graph shows simple trigger thresholds as lines: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: GraphType
fields.summary: How the graph is drawn: normal, stacked, pie or exploded. Defaults to normal.

fields.name: ShowLegend
fields.summary: Whether the graph shows a legend: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: Show3d
fields.summary: Whether a pie or exploded graph is drawn in 3D: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: PercentLeft
fields.summary: Percentile line drawn for the left Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

fields.name: PercentRight
fields.summary: Percentile line drawn for the right Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

fields.name: YminType
fields.summary: How the minimum of the Y axis is set: 0 calculated, 1 fixed value, 2 value of the item given in YminItemId. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: YmaxType
fields.summary: How the maximum of the Y axis is set: 0 calculated, 1 fixed value, 2 value of the item given in YmaxItemId. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: YminItemId
fields.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the minimum of the Y axis when the minimum type is item value.

fields.name: YmaxItemId
fields.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the maximum of the Y axis when the maximum type is item value.

fields.name: Flags
fields.summary: What low-level discovery made of the graph: a plain graph, a discovery rule or prototype, or one created by discovery.

fields.name: Uuid
fields.summary: Universal unique identifier that links the graph to its template across exports and imports; used only on templates and generated when omitted.

fields.name: Groups
fields.summary: What <c>selectGroups</c> adds.

fields.name: Hostgroups
fields.summary: What <c>selectHostGroups</c> adds.

fields.name: Templategroups
fields.summary: What <c>selectTemplateGroups</c> adds.

fields.name: Templates
fields.summary: What <c>selectTemplates</c> adds.

fields.name: Hosts
fields.summary: What <c>selectHosts</c> adds.

fields.name: Items
fields.summary: What <c>selectItems</c> adds.

fields.name: GraphItems
fields.summary: Items drawn on the graph with their display settings; returned when selectGraphItems is requested.

fields.name: DiscoveryRule
fields.summary: What <c>selectDiscoveryRule</c> adds.

fields.name: GraphDiscovery
fields.summary: What <c>selectGraphDiscovery</c> adds.

fields.name: DiscoveryData
fields.summary: What <c>selectDiscoveryData</c> adds.

types.name: GraphCreateRequest
types.summary: Write-request payload for the graph .create API method.

fields.name: Uuid
fields.summary: Universal unique identifier that links the graph to its template across exports and imports; used only on templates and generated when omitted.

fields.name: Name
fields.summary: Name of the graph. Required.

fields.name: YminItemId
fields.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the minimum of the Y axis when the minimum type is item value.

fields.name: YmaxItemId
fields.summary: ID of the item whose value sets the maximum of the Y axis when the maximum type is item value.

fields.name: GraphItems
fields.summary: Items to draw on the graph with their display settings; at least one is required.

fields.name: Width
fields.summary: Graph width, in pixels; 900 unless set.

fields.name: Height
fields.summary: Graph height, in pixels; 200 unless set.

fields.name: YAxisMin
fields.summary: Fixed minimum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymin_type</c> is fixed.

fields.name: YAxisMax
fields.summary: Fixed maximum of the Y axis, used when <c>ymax_type</c> is fixed.

fields.name: ShowWorkPeriod
fields.summary: Whether the graph highlights the working time: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: ShowTriggers
fields.summary: Whether the graph shows simple trigger thresholds as lines: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: GraphType
fields.summary: How the graph is drawn: normal, stacked, pie or exploded. Defaults to normal.

fields.name: ShowLegend
fields.summary: Whether the graph shows a legend: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: Show3d
fields.summary: Whether a pie or exploded graph is drawn in 3D: 0 no, 1 yes. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: PercentLeft
fields.summary: Percentile line drawn for the left Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

fields.name: PercentRight
fields.summary: Percentile line drawn for the right Y axis of a normal graph, as a percentage; 0 draws none.

fields.name: YMinType
fields.summary: How the minimum of the Y axis is set: 0 (the default) calculated, 1 a fixed value, 2 the value of an item.

fields.name: YMaxType
fields.summary: How the maximum of the Y axis is set: 0 (the default) calculated, 1 a fixed value, 2 the value of an item.

types.name: GraphDiscoveryData
types.summary: How low-level discovery created a graph or a graph prototype.

fields.name: ParentGraphId
fields.summary: The ID of the graph prototype that the object was discovered from.

fields.name: Status
fields.summary: The discovery state of the object: 0 discovered, 1 no longer discovered.

fields.name: TsDelete
fields.summary: When an object that is no longer discovered will be deleted, as a Unix timestamp; 0 if no deletion is scheduled.

types.name: GraphGetParameters
types.summary: Query parameters for the graph .get API method.

fields.name: GroupIds
fields.summary: Keeps graphs whose owning hosts or templates are members of any listed host or template group.

fields.name: TemplateIds
fields.summary: Keeps graphs owned by any of the listed templates.

fields.name: HostIds
fields.summary: Keeps graphs owned by any of the listed hosts or templates.

fields.name: GraphIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to the graphs whose IDs are listed.

fields.name: ItemIds
fields.summary: Keeps graphs that plot any of the listed items.

fields.name: Templated
fields.summary: When true, return only graphs that belong to templates; when false, only graphs on hosts.

fields.name: Inherited
fields.summary: When true, return only graphs inherited from a template; when false, only graphs that are not inherited.

fields.name: Editable
fields.summary: When true, return only objects the calling user has write permission to.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only results whose properties exactly match the given values; each key is a property name and each value is a single value or an array of accepted values.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only results whose given text properties contain the given strings; matching is case-insensitive.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: When true, return results that match any of the Filter or Search criteria instead of all of them.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: When true, the Search values must match the start of the property rather than any part of it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: When true, return results that do not match the Search criteria.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: When true, an asterisk in a Search value matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: Properties to return for each result; when omitted, all properties are returned.

fields.name: SelectGroups
fields.summary: Deprecated alias that returns the host groups in the groups property; use SelectHostGroups or SelectTemplateGroups instead. Zabbix 7.4 and later no longer support it.

fields.name: SelectHostGroups

fields.name: SelectTemplateGroups
fields.summary: Return the template groups of the templates the graph belongs to in the templategroups property.

fields.name: SelectTemplates
fields.summary: Return the templates the graph belongs to in the templates property.

fields.name: SelectHosts
fields.summary: Return the hosts or templates the graph belongs to in the hosts property.

fields.name: SelectItems
fields.summary: Return the items used in the graph in the items property.

fields.name: SelectGraphItems
fields.summary: Return the graph items in the gitems property.

fields.name: SelectDiscoveryRule
fields.summary: Return the discovery rule that created the graph in the discoveryRule property.

fields.name: SelectGraphDiscovery
fields.summary: Deprecated; returns the discovery data of a discovered graph in the graphDiscovery property. Use SelectDiscoveryData instead.

fields.name: CountOutput
fields.summary: When true, return the number of matching records instead of the records themselves.

fields.name: GroupCount
fields.summary: When true together with CountOutput, return a separate count for each value of the ID filter in use instead of a single total.

fields.name: PreserveKeys
fields.summary: When true, return the results as an object keyed by ID instead of an array.

fields.name: SortField
fields.summary: Properties to sort the results by; only the properties this method supports for sorting are accepted.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.summary: Sort direction for each sort field, ASC (the default) or DESC.

fields.name: Limit
fields.summary: Maximum number of records to return.

fields.name: SelectDiscoveryData
fields.summary: Return the discovery data of a discovered graph, such as the parent prototype, status and deletion time, in the discoveryData property.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.summary: ID of the item shown by the graph item.

fields.name: Color
fields.summary: Color of the graph item as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB value without a leading number sign.

fields.name: Drawtype
fields.summary: How the item is drawn: 0 line, 1 filled region, 2 bold line, 3 dot, 4 dashed line, 5 gradient line.

fields.name: Position
fields.summary: Zero-based drawing order of the item within the graph.

fields.name: Yaxisside

fields.name: CalcFnc
fields.summary: Value shown when several values fall into one pixel: 1 minimum, 2 average, 4 maximum, 7 all (line graphs only), 9 last (pie graphs only).

fields.name: GroupIds
fields.summary: Keeps graph prototypes whose hosts or templates are members of the listed host groups or template groups.

fields.name: TemplateIds
fields.summary: Keeps graph prototypes owned by any of the listed templates.

fields.name: HostIds
fields.summary: Keeps graph prototypes defined on any of the listed hosts or templates.

fields.name: GraphIds
fields.summary: Limits the result to the graph prototypes whose IDs are listed.

fields.name: ItemIds
fields.summary: Return only graph prototypes that draw the given items or item prototypes.

fields.name: DiscoveryIds
fields.summary: Keeps graph prototypes owned by any of the listed low-level discovery rules.

fields.name: Templated
fields.summary: When true, return only graph prototypes that belong to templates; when false, only those that belong to hosts.

fields.name: Inherited
fields.summary: When true, return only graph prototypes inherited from a template; when false, only those that are not inherited.

fields.name: Editable
fields.summary: Whether to return only graph prototypes that the current user is allowed to change.

fields.name: Filter
fields.summary: Return only graph prototypes whose properties exactly match the given values; besides the object properties it accepts host (the technical host name) and hostid.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Return only graph prototypes whose properties contain the given strings, using a case-insensitive substring match by default; each key is a property name.

fields.name: SearchByAny
fields.summary: Whether an object that matches any one of the search or filter criteria is returned; by default every criterion must match.

fields.name: StartSearch
fields.summary: Whether the search strings must match the beginning of the property value rather than any part of it.

fields.name: ExcludeSearch
fields.summary: Whether to return the objects that do not match the search criteria instead of those that do.

fields.name: SearchWildcardsEnabled
fields.summary: Whether an asterisk in a search string acts as a wildcard that matches any sequence of characters.

fields.name: Output
fields.summary: Which properties to return for each object, given as a list of property names or extend to return all of them.

fields.name: SelectTemplateGroups

fields.name: SelectTemplates

fields.name: GroupCount
fields.summary: Whether, together with countOutput, one count is returned per host group, host, item or discovery rule given in the ID filters instead of a single total.

fields.name: PreserveKeys

fields.name: SortField

fields.summary: The sort direction for each sort field, ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC); ascending when omitted.
